subject: Intrinsic functions
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB124 wave 2): the expression half of type 6 is now screened for the PROVABLY not-always-integral shapes, and ONLY those - soundness is the design: an arm fires only when a witness valuation yielding a non-integer exists. Arm 1: a root quotient of a BARE numeric item by an integral literal d>1 (always-integral only when d divides the item's picture granularity 10^-scale - so I/2 rejects, 9PP-item/100 stays legal). Arm 2: a scale>0 item occurring PURELY as additive leaves with net coefficient k where 10^scale does not divide k (consecutive results less than 1 apart). THE ROW'S OWN CLAIM WAS NARROWED (validate_the_premise): 'a division, a scaled operand inside an expression are decidable' is FALSE as stated - (I/2)*2, I/I, 362880/PIC-9, SCALED*10, SCALED-SCALED are all always-integral legal source, each defeats a broader screen, and the pb124_always_integral_zoo golden pins the whole complement compiling AND running. Everything outside the two sound arms fails open, as the original screen's doc demanded. The runtime landing of a residual non-integral value (silent truncation in Char) remains the documented fail-open disposition - a bind screen cannot see values, and the sound arms now catch the decidable shapes. ARM 3 (kb/Work PB617, wave 70 A): the LITERAL CONSTANT witness. CollectAdditive now folds every literal-only term of the additive spine exactly (ExactValue: +, -, *, /, unary -, integral literal exponent) into a constant and tracks whether every other term is provably integral (ProvablyIntegral: an integer item, or +, -, *, power over such terms); when both hold and the constant is not an integer, the expression's value is the constant plus an integer for EVERY valuation, so it is refused: CHAR(1.5 + 1) (2.5), CHAR(W-I + 0.5), CHAR((1.5)), CHAR(3 / 2 + 1). The constant is judged by VALUE: CHAR(1.5 + 0.5), CHAR(W-I + 1.5 + 1.5), CHAR(0.5 * 138) stay admitted; a term the fold can neither value nor prove integral (W-S * 2, W-I / 2, a function, a zero divide) keeps the screen failing open. DETERMINATION: the fold is exact/algebraic, not the arithmetic mode's rounded intermediate - type 6's 'will always result in an integer value' is a property of the expression. Witnesses: unit IntegerArgumentConstantWitnessTests (18 shapes), conformance:wiseowl/cases/15.3-Arguments/pb617_integer_arg_literal_constant, conformance:cases/15.3-Arguments/pb617-integer-expr-literal-sum.
